deck_title: Malley-Nusselt cosine-weighted hemisphere lift vs naive uniform solid-angle horizon waste rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Malley (1988) & Wilhelm Nusselt (1928) cosine-weighted hemisphere importance sampling via unit-disk vertical projection (r = sqrt(u), z = cos(theta) = sqrt(1 - u), p_cos(omega) = cos(theta)/pi, cancelling the Lambertian cos(theta)/pi integrand to lock estimator weight W_Malley(u) = 1.0000x with zero white-sky variance) versus naive uniform solid-angle hemisphere sampling (z = 1 - u, p_unif = 1/(2*pi), W_unif(u) = 2*(1 - u)) and 64-ring polar zenith CDF quadrature across 17 random strata (u in [0.0000, 1.0000]).
